assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.

Given the episodic nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate rhythm disturbances with clinical events, a cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated.
This service directly supports the documented diagnoses of I49.9 and I48.0.
The denial under PR-204 is inconsistent with the clinical indication.
Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271) has been denied.
The determination is based on Reason Code PR-204.
